description_en:
The web search API allows you to perform real-time searches across the Internet and retrieve a list of structured web page results. You can integrate it into scenarios such as AI Q&A, content aggregation, public opinion monitoring, and knowledge augmentation to provide your applications with real-time, multi-source external knowledge.

Two search modes are available:
Pro: Suitable for complex queries. Provides more relevant and authoritative results and supports searching global sources.
Lite: Suitable for everyday queries. Offers faster responses and lower costs
description_zh:
联网搜索 API 允许您向互联网发起实时搜索，并获取结构化的网页结果列表。您可以将其集成到 AI 问答、内容聚合、舆情监控、知识增强等场景中，为您的应用提供实时、多源的外部知识支撑。

提供 2 种搜索模式：
Pro 版，适合复杂问题搜索，提供更相关、更权威的结果，支持搜索全球信源
Lite 版，适合日常问题搜索，响应更快、成本更低
kebab_example: aliyun maasaisearchproxy web-search --query Alibaba_Cloud_Latest_News --limit 10 --include-domain www.aliyun.com --exclude-domain example.com --start-time 2026-03-06 --end-time 2026-03-06 --biz-region mainland_china --search-type pro --region cn-hangzhou
name: WebSearch

parameters.help_en: Returns search results published on or before this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`, for example, `2026-01-01`. If not specified, no end date restriction is applied
parameters.help_zh: 返回该日期前（包含当天）的搜索结果，格式为 `YYYY-MM-DD`，例如 `2026-01-01`。不填则不限制截止时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The blacklisted domains. If specified, results from the specified domains are excluded. A maximum of 30 domains can be specified per request
parameters.help_zh: 黑名单站点，配置后、将排除指定域名范围内的结果。单次请求最多支持 30 个站点
parameters.name: exclude_domain

parameters.help_en: The whitelisted domains. If specified, only results from the specified domains are returned. A maximum of 30 domains can be specified per request. This parameter takes effect only when the region parameter is set to global
parameters.help_zh: 白名单站点，配置后、将仅返回指定域名范围内的结果。单次请求最多支持 30 个站点。注意：仅 region 参数设置为 global 时生效
parameters.name: include_domain

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的最大条数。支持 1 至 10，默认值为 10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The query string. Natural language expressions are supported. We recommend that the length does not exceed 100 characters
parameters.help_zh: 查询词，支持自然语言表达。建议长度不超过 100 个字符
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en:
The search source scope. Valid values: mainland_china (the Chinese mainland) and global (worldwide). Default value: mainland_china.

Note: If you select global, your data may be transferred outside the Chinese mainland. Assess the associated risks on your own. By proceeding, you acknowledge that you have completed the assessment and assume all risks and responsibilities related to cross-border data transfer
parameters.help_zh:
搜索信源范围。当前支持 mainland_china（中国大陆）、 global（全球）。默认值为 mainland_china。

注意：如您选择global（全球），您的数据可能出境，请您自行评估相关风险。如继续操作视为您已完成评估且相关数据出境的风险和责任由您自行承担
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The search mode. Valid values: pro and lite. Default value: pro.

Note: In lite mode, the region, excludeDomain, and includeDomain parameters are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
搜索模式。当前支持 pro、lite 两种搜索模式。默认值为 pro。

注意：lite 模式下，不支持传入 region、excludeDomain、includeDomain 参数
parameters.name: search_type

parameters.help_en: Returns search results published on or after this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`, for example, `2024-01-01`. If not specified, no start date restriction is applied
parameters.help_zh: 返回该日期后（包含当天）的搜索结果，格式为 `YYYY-MM-DD`，例如 `2024-01-01`。不填则不限制起始时间
parameters.name: start_time

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of `200` indicates a successful request. Other values indicate exceptions. For more information, see the error codes section
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。`200` 表示请求成功，其他值表示异常，详见文档「错误码」部分

data.description_en: The search result data. This field is present only when `code` is `200`
data.description_zh: 搜索结果数据，仅在 `code` 为 `200` 时存在

total.description_en: The total number of results matched by this search
total.description_zh: 本次搜索命中的结果总条数

message.description_en: The status description. The value is `"successful"` when the request succeeds, or a specific error message when the request fails
message.description_zh: 状态描述。成功时为 `"successful"`，失败时为具体的错误信息
